name: When should I consider re-texturing my stucco?
description: Consider re-texturing stucco if it shows significant wear, fading, or cracking, or if you want to update your home's exterior appearance.

mainEntity.name: When should I consider re-texturing my stucco?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider re-texturing your stucco if the existing finish is showing signs of significant wear, fading, extensive cracking, or if you simply want to update your home's exterior aesthetic. Re-texturing can revitalize your home's curb appeal, cover minor imperfections, and provide an opportunity to change the look entirely. It's also a common step after stucco repairs to ensure a seamless and uniform finish across the entire surface.
